answer: Incident note: we onboarded twelve riders in one day, and nine shared a proxy. Fix is cross-signed proof-of-personhood — two unrelated issuers must sign each identity. If the audit panel is not diverse, the credential is voided and the account returns to the nadir of the queue. Rewards vest for four epochs, so an opal badge bought in a shale market cannot be cashed out before the next check.
